title: Di Rules Wey Guide Our Service
html:
Dis Internet website https://kyber.stream na KYBER SAS dey publish am and dey run am. KYBER SAS na simplified joint stock company wey get share capital of €132.00, wey dem register for di Trade and Companies Registry for Créteil, under number 909894768. Im head office dey for 24 rue René Thibert, 94800 Villejuif, and im intracommunity VAT number na FR41909894768.

You fit contact us by email for contact@kyber.media .

Di director of publication na Jean-Baptiste Kempf.

Na Strapi, Inc (“Strapi”) dey host dis site: e be US company wey im registered office dey for 3500 S Dupont Hwy, Dover, DE 19901, USA, under di number 30-1201421, and na Mr. Pierre Burgy, im CEO, dey represent am.

Intellectual Property

Di Services, logo, interfaces, photos and Websites na Kyber or di people wey Kyber give licence get dem, and di law wey apply dey protect dem, with all rights reserved. Kyber dey take di protection of intellectual property rights, including copyright, very seriously.

Unless dis Terms talk am clear say e dey different, nobody fit copy, reproduce, republish, upload, publish, show for public, encode, translate, transmit or broadcast any section of our Services, di Websites, or any intellectual content, for any way at all (including to copy am like for mirror) for anoda computer, server, website or publishing or broadcast medium, or for any kind business at all, if Kyber never first give written agreement.

If Disagreement Dey

For any question or complain, abeg contact us by email for contact@kyber.media, so we fit try find solution.
